# st-unitycatalog_user (Resource)

Manages a user in Unity Catalog via the SCIM2 Users API (/api/1.0/unity-control/scim2/Users).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "st-unitycatalog_user" "user" {
  schemas      = ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"]
  display_name = "myucuser"
  emails = [{
    value   = "myucuser@mytestuc.com"
    primary = true
  }]
  active = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the user.
- `emails` (Attributes List) The list of user emails. Changing this value forces replacement of the resource, because emails are immutable in Unity Catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--emails))
- `schemas` (List of String) The SCIM2 schema URNs for the user resource, e.g. ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"].

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The SCIM2 identifier of the user, assigned by the server. This attribute is not user configurable but is sent back to the server in PUT requests as required by the SCIM2 API.

<a id="nestedatt--emails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `emails`

Required:

- `value` (String) The email address.

Optional:

- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary email. Defaults to false.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by user ID shown in Unity Catalog.
terraform import 'st-unitycatalog_user.user' 'ccdd3d6d-e15e-43e0-835d-7dbf9577bdd8'
```
